title: Apple wins dismissal of parts of a class action alleging it violated CA privacy law by collecting user data from its apps despite users believing they opted out (Isaiah Poritz/Bloomberg Law)
summary: Isaiah Poritz / Bloomberg Law: Apple wins dismissal of parts of a class action alleging it violated CA privacy law by collecting user data from its apps despite users believing they opted out — Apple Inc. defeated claims that it violated California privacy law when it allegedly collected user data from its in-house apps …
